title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This strap-like muscle is the longest in your body.
Watch the long band crossing the front of the thigh.
The rectus femoris is thicker and runs straight down the thigh.
This one slants from the front of the hip to the inner knee.
Why it matters: its name comes from the Latin word for tailor.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This is the biggest muscle in the human body. Name it.
We're looking from behind at the hip.
The gluteus medius lies partly beneath it, higher on the hip.
This one forms the bulk of your buttock and extends the hip.
Why it matters: it powers climbing stairs and standing up.
